request: A box 100 x 70 x 50 mm with a separate lid that rotates on two pin hinges along the back edge. The pins are 4 mm in diameter and pass through knuckles on both the box and the lid with 0.3 mm clearance.
A two-part enclosure 80 x 50 x 30 mm whose lid snaps onto the base: four cantilever snap hooks on the lid engage matching recesses cut into the inside of the base walls.
A desk clamp: a C-shaped clamp for a desk edge up to 40 mm thick with a screw boss on the lower jaw, and an upright post on top of the clamp that tilts 15 degrees back from vertical.
A drawer organizer tray 200 x 120 x 40 mm with a 4 x 3 grid of hexagonal pockets, each 30 mm across flats, separated by 2 mm walls.
A pipe tee fitting: a 60 mm long main tube with 25 mm outer diameter and 2.5 mm walls, and a branch tube of the same size joining it at 90 degrees at its middle, hollow through both.
A mounting plate 120 x 80 x 6 mm with two parallel shafts 50 mm apart, and two gear blanks of 40 mm and 60 mm outer diameter, 8 mm thick, sitting on the shafts 0.5 mm above the plate.
A wall bracket whose arm is a quarter-circle of 120 mm radius with a 20 x 10 mm cross-section, joining a vertical wall plate to a horizontal ring of 50 mm inner diameter at the far end.
A drawer unit: an outer shell 150 x 120 x 80 mm with two internal side rails, and a drawer that slides on those rails with 0.5 mm clearance on each side and a pull handle on its front.
A lamp mount: a round base 100 mm in diameter, a 150 mm arm rising from the base at 60 degrees, and a ring holder at the top of the arm that stays horizontal.
A stackable crate 160 x 120 x 90 mm with 3 mm walls, a row of six ventilation slots on each of the four sides, and a stacking lip on the top rim that fits inside the bottom of an identical crate.
A headphone stand: a round weighted base, a vertical post, and a curved saddle at the top shaped as a 120 degree arc of 50 mm radius for the headband to rest on.

A shelf bracket with a 150 mm wall plate, a 200 mm shelf arm and a diagonal brace between them. The arm angle is a parameter between 80 and 100 degrees, and the brace must stay attached to both at any angle.

Design a desktop phone and tablet dock with a hinged storage lid. All dimensions in mm.

Base: a rectangular base plate 180 wide (X), 120 deep (Y) and 8 thick, sitting on the build plate. Cut four 5 mm through-holes for mounting screws, one 12 mm in from each corner.

Phone cradle: on the front-left of the base, a backrest 80 wide, 110 tall and 6 thick that leans back 70 degrees from the base plane, with a front lip 80 wide, 12 tall and 6 deep at its foot to stop the phone sliding. Leave a 10 mm wide, 15 mm deep slot through the lip and backrest for a charging cable.

Tablet slot: on the right half of the base, two parallel upright walls 70 wide and 60 tall, 14 apart on their inner faces, so a 12 mm thick tablet fits with 1 mm clearance on each side.

Storage box: at the back of the base, an open-top box 160 wide, 40 deep and 30 tall with 3 mm walls, for pens and cables. Divide it into four equal compartments with 2 mm internal walls.

Lid: a separate flat lid 160 wide, 40 deep and 4 thick that covers the storage box and rotates on two pin hinges along the box's back edge. The pins are 4 mm in diameter and pass through knuckles on both the box and the lid with 0.3 mm clearance. The lid must stay a separate solid.

Make the lean angle, the tablet gap, the box height and the compartment count adjustable parameters. No fillets or chamfers. Nothing may go below the base.
